recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published issue without reopening later resource-type/chaining decisions; any broader SearchParameter FHIRPath validation or tooling policy should remain separate work.
issue_request: FHIR-22653 was Published/Persuasive for FHIR-I and asked to add a SearchParameter attribute containing a FHIRPath constraint that describes when a SearchParameter applies, with Bundle-composition and Bundle-message as the motivating examples.
initial_application: HL7/fhir#2144, merged as 435d9997524b26dd3a648c0237dcae1fe7f4a834, added SearchParameter.constraint to the SearchParameter StructureDefinition and added SearchParameter/example-constraint. The implementation commit 76ce0e716b7f3a31f6573fe90b24ee0443e77707 had a subject typo referencing FHIR-22635 and did not add constraint values to the active Bundle-composition or Bundle-message search parameters.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes and the linked Zulip thread confirm the WG wanted the document/message applicability condition explicit rather than buried in SearchParameter.expression. Later FHIR-31664 narrowed the same Bundle expressions to Composition and MessageHeader, and FHIR-48363 changed their type to resource for embedded-resource chaining; those later decisions did not encode the Bundle.type applicability condition. source/fhir.ini keeps both bundle and searchparameter active in the current build.
reconciliation: Committed a focused source fix on the combined branch that adds Bundle.type='document' and Bundle.type='message' FHIRPath constraints to source/bundle/bundle-Bundle-search-params.xml while preserving the current resource search type and type-narrowed expressions.
source_changes: source/bundle/bundle-Bundle-search-params.xml: added SearchParameter.constraint to Bundle-composition with Bundle.type = 'document' and entry[0].resource is Composition.
source/bundle/bundle-Bundle-search-params.xml: added SearchParameter.constraint to Bundle-message with Bundle.type = 'message' and entry[0].resource is MessageHeader.

related_jiras.note: This later Published issue narrowed the same Bundle-composition and Bundle-message expressions to Composition and MessageHeader; the reconciliation preserves that change and adds only the missing Bundle.type applicability constraints.

This later Applied issue changed the same Bundle search parameters from reference to the new resource search type for embedded-resource chaining; the added constraints are compatible with that current shape.
This later SearchParameter FHIRPath guidance confirms full FHIRPath remains allowed while leaving broader validation/tooling policy outside the seed issue.
